--==============================================================================

function extractCardData(cardObj)
        if not cardObj then return nil end

        -- Only allow Tile objects
        if cardObj.tag ~= "Tile" then
            broadcastToAll("Ignored object: Only Tile objects can be saved.", {1, 0.5, 0})
            return nil
        end

        local cardData = {
            name = cardObj.getName() or "Unknown Ship",
            json = nil,
            imageURL = "",
            tonnage = "Light",
            baseScale = 1,
        }

        -- Capture the exact JSON of the object (Tile)
        -- We use this exactly as saved for spawning
        cardData.json = cardObj.getJSON()

        -- Extract Image URL for the UI listing (from CustomObject)
        local customObj = cardObj.getCustomObject()
        if customObj and customObj.image then
            cardData.imageURL = customObj.image
        end

        -- Tonnage detection from Description (check for specific ship types)
        local desc = cardObj.getDescription() or ""
        local descLower = string.lower(desc)
        local name = cardObj.getName() or ""
        nameLower = string.lower(name)

        -- Check both description and name for ship type
        local text = descLower .. " " .. nameLower

        -- Ordered from largest to smallest for proper detection
        if string.find(text, "dreadnought") or string.find(text, "dreadnaught") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Dreadnaught"
        elseif string.find(text, "super battleship") or string.find(text, "superbattleship") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Super Battleship"
        elseif string.find(text, "supercarrier") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Supercarrier"
        elseif string.find(text, "battleship") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Battleship"
        elseif string.find(text, "battlecruiser") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Battlecruiser"
        elseif string.find(text, "troopship") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Troopship"
        elseif string.find(text, "heavy cruiser") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Heavy Cruiser"
        elseif string.find(text, "light cruiser") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Light Cruiser"
          elseif string.find(text, "cruiser") then
              cardData.tonnage = "Cruiser"
        elseif string.find(text, "runner") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Runner"
        elseif string.find(text, "destroyer") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Destroyer"
        elseif string.find(text, "cutter") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Cutter"
        elseif string.find(text, "monitor") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Monitor"
        elseif string.find(text, "carrier") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Carrier"
        elseif string.find(text, "frigate") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Frigate"
        elseif string.find(text, "lighter") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Lighter"
        elseif string.find(text, "corvette") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Corvette"
        elseif string.find(text, "cell") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Cell"
        else
            cardData.tonnage = "Other" -- Default for unrecognized types
        end

        -- Attempt to find baseScale in the Lua script for Tonnage Category sorting
        -- (This preserves the existing logic for categorizing ships in the UI)
        local script = cardObj.getLuaScript()
        if script then
            local scale = script:match("baseScale%s*=%s*([%d%.]+)")
            if scale then
                cardData.baseScale = tonumber(scale)
            end
        end

        -- Extract ShipbaseSize from the card's JSON to determine ship tonnage
        -- ShipbaseSize is embedded in the ship model's LuaScript within the card JSON
        cardData.shipTonnage = extractShipTonnageFromObj(cardObj)

    return cardData
end

-- Extracts the ship tonnage (Light/Medium/Heavy/Colossal) from a card object's JSON
-- by finding the ShipbaseSize variable in the embedded ship model LuaScript
function extractShipTonnageFromObj(cardObj)
    local jsonStr = cardObj.getJSON()
    if jsonStr then
        return extractShipTonnageFromJSON(jsonStr)
    end
    return "Light" -- Default fallback
end

-- Extracts the ship tonnage from a raw JSON string by searching for ShipbaseSize
function extractShipTonnageFromJSON(jsonStr)
    if not jsonStr then return "Light" end
    local shipbaseSize = jsonStr:match("ShipbaseSize%s*=%s*(%d+)")
    if shipbaseSize then
        local size = tonumber(shipbaseSize)
        if CONFIG.SHIPBASE_TO_TONNAGE[size] then
            return CONFIG.SHIPBASE_TO_TONNAGE[size]
        end
    end
    return "Light" -- Default fallback
end

-- Ensures all savedShipCards have shipTonnage set (backward compat for old embedded data)
function ensureShipTonnage()
    for _, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
        if not card.shipTonnage or card.shipTonnage == "" then
            if card.json then
                card.shipTonnage = extractShipTonnageFromJSON(card.json)
            else
                card.shipTonnage = "Light"
            end
        end
    end
end

function sortShipCards()
        table.sort(savedShipCards, function(a, b)
        return (a.name or "") < (b.name or "")
    end)
end

function uiShowCustomTooltip(player, value, id)
        local playerColor = player.color
        local tooltipText = value or ""

        -- Support a "BIG|" prefix to indicate a larger tooltip for emphasis (used for class and tonnage tabs)
        local isBig = false
        if tooltipText:sub(1,4) == "BIG|" then
            isBig = true
            tooltipText = tooltipText:sub(5)
        end

        local cfg = CONFIG.UI

        if isBig then
            self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltip_" .. playerColor, "width", tostring(cfg.TOOLTIP_WIDTH))
            self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltip_" .. playerColor, "height", tostring(cfg.TOOLTIP_HEIGHT))
            self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltipText_" .. playerColor, "fontSize", tostring(cfg.TOOLTIP_FONT_SIZE))
        else
            -- Ensure defaults for normal tooltips
            self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltip_" .. playerColor, "width", "400")
            self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltip_" .. playerColor, "height", "60")
            self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltipText_" .. playerColor, "fontSize", "18")
        end

        self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltip_" .. playerColor, "active", "true")
    self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltipText_" .. playerColor, "text", tooltipText)
end

function uiHideCustomTooltip(player, value, id)
        local playerColor = player.color

        -- Reset to defaults and hide
        self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltip_" .. playerColor, "active", "false")
        self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltip_" .. playerColor, "width", "400")
        self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltip_" .. playerColor, "height", "60")
    self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltipText_" .. playerColor, "text", "")
    self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltipText_" .. playerColor, "fontSize", "18")
end

function getFilteredCards(activeTab, activeTonnageTab, searchFilter)
        local filtered = {}
        local searchLower = string.lower(searchFilter or "")

        for i, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
            local matchesClassTab = (not activeTab) or (card.tonnage == activeTab)
            local matchesTonnageTab = (not activeTonnageTab) or (card.shipTonnage == activeTonnageTab)
            local matchesSearch = (searchFilter == "") or string.find(string.lower(card.name or ""), searchLower, 1, true)

            if matchesClassTab and matchesTonnageTab and matchesSearch then
                local cardCopy = duplicateTable(card)
                cardCopy.originalIndex = i
                table.insert(filtered, cardCopy)
            end
        end

    return filtered
end

function countCardsInCategory(categoryName)
        local count = 0
        for _, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
            if card.tonnage == categoryName then
                count = count + 1
            end
        end
    return count
end

function countCardsInTonnage(tonnageName)
        local count = 0
        for _, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
            if card.shipTonnage == tonnageName then
                count = count + 1
            end
        end
    return count
end

function escapeXml(str)
        if not str then return "" end
        str = str:gsub("&", "&")
        str = str:gsub("<", "<")
        str = str:gsub(">", ">")
        str = str:gsub('"', """)
        str = str:gsub("'", "'")
    return str
end

function uiNextCard(player, value, id)
        local playerColor = player.color

        local activeTab = playerActiveTabs[playerColor]
        local activeTonnageTab = playerActiveTonnageTabs[playerColor]
        local searchFilter = playerSearchFilters[playerColor] or ""
        local filteredCards = getFilteredCards(activeTab, activeTonnageTab, searchFilter)
        local total = #filteredCards

        if total == 0 then return end

        local index = playerCardIndices[playerColor] or 1
        index = index + 1
        if index > total then index = 1 end

    playerCardIndices[playerColor] = index
    Wait.time(function() showShipPickerUI(playerColor) end, 0.1)
end

function uiPrevCard(player, value, id)
        local playerColor = player.color

        local activeTab = playerActiveTabs[playerColor]

        local searchFilter = playerSearchFilters[playerColor] or ""
        local filteredCards = getFilteredCards(activeTab, activeTonnageTab, searchFilter)
        local total = #filteredCards

        if total == 0 then return end

        local index = playerCardIndices[playerColor] or 1
        index = index - 1
        if index < 1 then index = total end

    playerCardIndices[playerColor] = index
    Wait.time(function() showShipPickerUI(playerColor) end, 0.1)
end

function uiSpawnCards(player, value, id)
        local playerColor = player.color

        local activeTab = playerActiveTabs[playerColor]
        local activeTonnageTab = playerActiveTonnageTabs[playerColor]
        local searchFilter = playerSearchFilters[playerColor] or ""
        local filteredCards = getFilteredCards(activeTab, activeTonnageTab, searchFilter)
        local index = playerCardIndices[playerColor] or 1

        local card = filteredCards[index]

        if not card then
            broadcastToColor("No ship selected to spawn.", playerColor, {1, 0.5, 0.5})
        return
    end

    spawnCardsForPlayer(playerColor, {card.originalIndex})
    broadcastToColor("Spawned " .. card.name .. " in " .. playerColor .. " play area!", playerColor, {0.2, 1, 0.2})
end

    -- Spawns selected cards for a player at their play area
    function spawnCardsForPlayer(playerColor, cardIndices)
        if not playerSpawnCounts then playerSpawnCounts = {} end

        local spawnConfig = CONFIG.PLAYER_SPAWN_POSITIONS[playerColor]

        if not spawnConfig then
            -- Default spawn position if player color not configured
            spawnConfig = {
                position = {x = 0, y = 1, z = 0},
                rotation = {x = 0, y = 0, z = 0},
                direction = {x = 1, y = 0, z = 0},
            }
            broadcastToColor("Warning: No spawn position configured for " .. playerColor .. ", using center.", playerColor, {1, 1, 0})
        end

        local startPos = spawnConfig.position
        local rotation = spawnConfig.rotation
        local direction = spawnConfig.direction
        local spacing = CONFIG.CARD_SPAWN_SPACING
        local cardsPerRow = CONFIG.CARDS_PER_ROW or 6

        -- Calculate perpendicular "row" direction (rotated 90 degrees on the horizontal plane)
        local rowDirection = {
            x = direction.z,
            y = 0,
            z = direction.x,
        }

        -- Get persistent spawn count for this player
        local currentCount = playerSpawnCounts[playerColor] or 0

        for i, cardIndex in ipairs(cardIndices) do
            local card = savedShipCards[cardIndex]
            if card and card.json then
                -- Calculate column and row from cumulative count
                local col = currentCount % cardsPerRow
                local row = math.floor(currentCount / cardsPerRow)

                -- Calculate spawn position: col along direction, row along perpendicular
                local colOffset = col * spacing
                local rowOffset = row * spacing
                local spawnPos = {
                    x = startPos.x + (direction.x * colOffset) + (rowDirection.x * rowOffset),
                    y = startPos.y,
                    z = startPos.z + (direction.z * colOffset) + (rowDirection.z * rowOffset),
                }

                -- Spawn the card
                spawnObjectJSON({
                    json = card.json,
                    position = spawnPos,
                    rotation = rotation,
                    sound = true,
                })

                -- Increment count for next card
                currentCount = currentCount + 1
            end
        end

    -- Update persistent count
    playerSpawnCounts[playerColor] = currentCount
end

function duplicateTable(oldTable)
        if type(oldTable) ~= "table" then return oldTable end

        local newTable = {}
        for k, v in pairs(oldTable) do
            if type(v) == "table" then
                newTable[k] = duplicateTable(v)
            else
                newTable[k] = v
            end
        end
    return newTable
end

function round(num, dec)
        local mult = 10 ^ (dec or 0)
    return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
end

function stripBrackets(str)
        if not str then return "" end
        -- Check for [=[ ... ]=] style first
        local s, e = str:find("^%[=%[.*%]=%]$")
        if s then return str:sub(4, -4) end

        -- Check for [[ ... ]] style
        s, e = str:find("^%[%[.*%]%]$")
        if s then return str:sub(3, -3) end

    return str
end

function parseAndSpawnList(listText, playerColor)
    local lines = splitIntoLines(listText)
    local shipEntries = extractShipEntries(lines)

    if #shipEntries == 0 then
        broadcastToColor("No ships found in the list. Make sure the format is correct.", playerColor, {1, 0.5, 0})
        return
    end

    local spawnedCount = 0
    local notFoundList = {}

    -- Only spawn one of each ship from the list (duplicates and quantities are ignored)
    local seen = {}
    local uniqueEntries = {}
    for _, entry in ipairs(shipEntries) do
        local key = (entry.name or ""):lower()
        key = trimString(key)
        if key ~= "" and not seen[key] then
            seen[key] = true
            table.insert(uniqueEntries, entry)
        end
    end

    for _, entry in ipairs(uniqueEntries) do
        local shipName = entry.name
        local matchedCards = findMatchingCards(shipName)

        if #matchedCards > 0 then
            local cardIndex = matchedCards[1]
            spawnCardsForPlayer(playerColor, {cardIndex})
            spawnedCount = spawnedCount + 1
        else
            table.insert(notFoundList, shipName)
        end
    end

    if spawnedCount > 0 then
        broadcastToColor("Spawned " .. spawnedCount .. " ship cards from list.", playerColor, {0.2, 1, 0.3})
    end

    if #notFoundList > 0 then
        local notFoundMsg = "Warning: Could not find cards for: "
        for i, name in ipairs(notFoundList) do
            if i > 1 then notFoundMsg = notFoundMsg .. ", " end
            notFoundMsg = notFoundMsg .. name
            if i >= 5 then
                notFoundMsg = notFoundMsg .. " (and more...)"
                break
            end
        end
        broadcastToColor(notFoundMsg, playerColor, {1, 1, 0})
    end
end

function splitIntoLines(text)
        local lines = {}
        local currentLine = ""
        for i = 1, #text do
            local char = text:sub(i, i)
            if char == "\n" or char == "\r" then
                if #currentLine > 0 then
                    table.insert(lines, currentLine)
                    currentLine = ""
                end
            else
                currentLine = currentLine .. char
            end
        end
        if #currentLine > 0 then
            table.insert(lines, currentLine)
        end
    return lines
end

function removeLineNumber(line)
        local dotPos = findChar(line, ".")
        if dotPos and dotPos < 5 then
            local beforeDot = trimString(line:sub(1, dotPos - 1))
            if isNumeric(beforeDot) then
                return trimString(line:sub(dotPos + 1))
            end
        end
    return line
end

function extractShipEntries(lines)
        local entries = {}
        for _, line in ipairs(lines) do
            line = trimString(line)
            if #line > 0 and not isHeaderLine(line) then
                local entry = parseShipLine(line)
                if entry then
                    table.insert(entries, entry)
                end
            end
        end
    return entries
end

function isHeaderLine(line)
        if #line == 0 then return true end
        if line:sub(1, 1) == "#" then return true end

    local lowerLine = line:lower()

    if contains(lowerLine, "configuration") or
       contains(lowerLine, "game size") or
       contains(lowerLine, "fleet ++") or
       contains(lowerLine, "famous admirals") then
        return true
    end

    if (contains(lowerLine, "admirals") or contains(lowerLine, "groups")) and
       contains(lowerLine, "[") and contains(lowerLine, "pts]") then
        if not contains(lowerLine, "•") and not contains(line, "x ") then
            return true
        end
    end

    return false
end

function parseShipLine(line)
    line = trimString(line)
    if #line == 0 then return nil end

    line = removeLineNumber(line)
    line = trimString(line)

    local colonPos = findChar(line, ":")
    local bulletPresent = (line:sub(1, 1) == "•" or line:sub(1, 1) == "-" or line:sub(1, 1) == "*")

    if colonPos == #line and not bulletPresent then
        local hasQuantity = false
        for i = 1, 6 do
            if i < #line and line:sub(i, i) == "x" and line:sub(i+1, i+1) == " " then
                hasQuantity = true
                break
            end
        end
        if not hasQuantity then
            return nil
        end
    end

    if bulletPresent then
        line = trimString(line:sub(2))
    end

    local quantity = 1
    local xPos = findChar(line, "x")
    if xPos and xPos < 6 then
        local beforeX = trimString(line:sub(1, xPos - 1))
        if isNumeric(beforeX) then
            quantity = tonumber(beforeX) or 1
            line = trimString(line:sub(xPos + 2))
        end
    end

    local bracketPos = findChar(line, "[")
    colonPos = findChar(line, ":")

    local nameEnd = #line
    if bracketPos and (not colonPos or bracketPos < colonPos) then
        nameEnd = bracketPos - 1
    elseif colonPos then
        nameEnd = colonPos - 1
    end

    local shipName = trimString(line:sub(1, nameEnd))

    if #shipName < 3 then return nil end

    local lowerName = shipName:lower()

    if contains(lowerName, "lvl ") or contains(lowerName, "captain") or contains(lowerName, "admiral") then
        return nil
    end

    if contains(shipName, " - ") and (shipName:sub(-2) == " -" or contains(shipName, "pts]")) then
        return nil
    end

    return {name = shipName, quantity = quantity}
end

-- Normalise a ship name for comparisons
local function normaliseName(s)
    s = trimString((s or ""):lower())
    -- collapse whitespace
    s = s:gsub("%s+", " ")
    -- strip common punctuation that can break matching
    s = s:gsub("[%[%]%(%)%{%}%.,:;\"']", "")
    return s
end

-- Whole-word / phrase boundary match (Lua frontier patterns)
local function hasWholeWord(haystack, needle)
    if not haystack or not needle or needle == "" then return false end
    -- treat spaces in needle as literal spaces (already normalised)
    -- %f[%w] and %f[%W] give word boundaries for alnum/underscore
    local pattern = "%f[%w]" .. needle:gsub(" ", "%%s+") .. "%f[%W]"
    return haystack:find(pattern) ~= nil
end

-- Apply your specific overlap rules
local function disambiguationPenalty(search, card)
    -- Known overlaps:
    --   Light Cruiser / Heavy Cruiser / Cruiser
    --   Heavy Frigate / Frigate
    -- Penalty is large enough to effectively exclude the wrong hull.
    if card == "cruiser" then
        if search:find("light cruiser", 1, true) or search:find("heavy cruiser", 1, true) then
            return 10000
        end
    end
    if card == "frigate" then
        if search:find("heavy frigate", 1, true) then
            return 10000
        end
    end

    -- Also avoid matching specific hulls when the list asked for the generic
    if search == "cruiser" and (card == "light cruiser" or card == "heavy cruiser") then
        return 200
    end
    if search == "frigate" and card == "heavy frigate" then
        return 200
    end

    return 0
end

-- Score how good a candidate card name is for a search name
local function matchScore(searchRaw, cardRaw)
    local search = normaliseName(searchRaw)
    local card   = normaliseName(cardRaw)

    if search == "" or card == "" then return nil end

    local score = nil

    -- Highest priority: exact match
    if card == search then
        score = 100000
    -- Next: whole-word / phrase match either direction
    elseif hasWholeWord(search, card) then
        score = 80000 + #card
    elseif hasWholeWord(card, search) then
        -- prefer closer length to avoid "Cruiser" matching "Light Cruiser"
        local lenPenalty = math.abs(#card - #search)
        score = 70000 + #search - (lenPenalty * 10)
    -- Fallback: substring checks (least reliable)
    elseif contains(search, card) then
        score = 50000 + #card
    elseif contains(card, search) then
        local lenPenalty = math.abs(#card - #search)
        score = 40000 + #search - (lenPenalty * 10)
    else
        return nil
    end

    -- Apply overlap penalties
    score = score - disambiguationPenalty(search, card)

    -- If the penalty killed it, reject
    if score <= 0 then return nil end
    return score
end


function findMatchingCards(searchName)
    local scored = {}

    for i, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
        local s = matchScore(searchName, card.name or "")
        if s then
            table.insert(scored, {index = i, score = s, name = card.name or ""})
        end
    end

    table.sort(scored, function(a, b)
        if a.score == b.score then
            -- stable-ish tie breaker: shorter name tends to be the more "exact hull"
            return #a.name < #b.name
        end
        return a.score > b.score
    end)

    local matches = {}
    for _, item in ipairs(scored) do
        table.insert(matches, item.index)
    end
    return matches
end

function trimString(str)
    if not str then return "" end
    local startPos = 1
    while startPos <= #str do
        local char = str:sub(startPos, startPos)
        if char ~= " " and char ~= "\t" and char ~= "\r" and char ~= "\n" then
            break
        end
        startPos = startPos + 1
    end
    local endPos = #str
    while endPos >= 1 do
        local char = str:sub(endPos, endPos)
        if char ~= " " and char ~= "\t" and char ~= "\r" and char ~= "\n" then
            break
        end
        endPos = endPos - 1
    end
    if startPos > endPos then return "" end
    return str:sub(startPos, endPos)
end

function findChar(str, char)
    for i = 1, #str do
        if str:sub(i, i) == char then
            return i
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function contains(str, substr)
    if not str or not substr then return false end
    if #substr > #str then return false end
    for i = 1, #str - #substr + 1 do
        local match = true
        for j = 1, #substr do
            if str:sub(i + j - 1, i + j - 1) ~= substr:sub(j, j) then
                match = false
                break
            end
        end
        if match then return true end
    end
    return false
end

function isNumeric(str)
    if not str or #str == 0 then return false end
    for i = 1, #str do
        local char = str:sub(i, i)
        if char < "0" or char > "9" then
            return false
        end
    end
    return true
end

            height = 350,
            width = 800,
            font_size = 250,

function createSetupActionButtons()
        self.clearButtons()
        self.clearInputs()

        -- Compact stacked layout (vertical) — smaller buttons
        local btnHeight = 60
        local btnWidth  = 380
        local btnFont   = 60
        local zStart    = 1.2
        local zSpacing  = -0.25

        -- Cancel button (top)
        createButton_helper({
            label = "Cancel",

            position = {0, 1, zStart},
            height = btnHeight,
            width = btnWidth,
            font_size = btnFont,

        })

        createButton_helper({

            height = btnHeight,
            width = btnWidth,

        if not fresh then

--==============================================================================
-- SETUP MODE FUNCTIONS
--==============================================================================

function buttonClick_setup()
        savedShipCardsBackup = duplicateTable(savedShipCards)
    createSetupActionButtons()
    broadcastToAll("Setup Mode: Box-select ship cards, then click Add/Remove", {1, 1, 1})
end

function buttonClick_cancel()
        savedShipCards = savedShipCardsBackup

        if #savedShipCards == 0 then
            createSetupButton()
        else
            createMainButtonsWithList()
        end

    broadcastToAll("Setup Canceled", {1, 1, 1})
end

function buttonClick_add(obj, player_color)
        local selectedObjs = Player[player_color].getSelectedObjects()
        local count = 0

        for _, selectedObj in ipairs(selectedObjs) do
            if selectedObj and not selectedObj.isDestroyed() and selectedObj ~= self then
                -- Check if it's a card or tile
                if selectedObj.tag == "Card" or selectedObj.tag == "Tile" then
                    -- Check if already saved (by name comparison)
                    local cardName = selectedObj.getName()
                    local alreadyExists = false

                    for _, saved in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
                        if saved.name == cardName then
                            alreadyExists = true
                            break
                        end
                    end

                    if not alreadyExists then
                        -- Extract card data
                        local cardData = extractCardData(selectedObj)
                        if cardData then
                            table.insert(savedShipCards, cardData)
                            count = count + 1
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        if count > 0 then
            fresh = false
            -- Sort cards alphabetically
            sortShipCards()
            updateSave()
            broadcastToAll(count .. " ship card(s) added to " .. CONFIG.FACTION_NAME .. " Ship Picker", {0.2, 1, 0.2})
        else
            broadcastToAll("No new cards to add (select Card objects)", {1, 0.5, 0.5})
        end

    createMainButtonsWithList()
end

function buttonClick_remove(obj, player_color)
        local selectedObjs = Player[player_color].getSelectedObjects()
        local count = 0

        local newSavedCards = {}

        for _, saved in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
            local shouldRemove = false

            for _, selectedObj in ipairs(selectedObjs) do
                if selectedObj and not selectedObj.isDestroyed() then
                    if selectedObj.getName() == saved.name then
                        shouldRemove = true
                        count = count + 1
                        break
                    end
                end
            end

            if not shouldRemove then
                table.insert(newSavedCards, saved)
            end
        end

        savedShipCards = newSavedCards

        if #savedShipCards == 0 then
            fresh = true
            createSetupButton()
        else
            createMainButtonsWithList()
        end

        updateSave()
    broadcastToAll(count .. " ship card(s) removed from " .. CONFIG.FACTION_NAME .. " Ship Picker", {1, 0.5, 0.5})
end

function buttonClick_reset()
        fresh = true
        savedShipCards = {}
        savedShipCardsBackup = {}
        playerSelections = {}
        playerSearchFilters = {}
        playerActiveTabs = {}
        playerSpawnCounts = {}

        createSetupButton()
        updateSave()
    broadcastToAll(CONFIG.FACTION_NAME .. " Ship Picker Reset", {1, 1, 1})
end

--==============================================================================
-- CARD DATA EXTRACTION
--==============================================================================

function extractCardData(cardObj)
        if not cardObj then return nil end

        -- Only allow Tile objects
        if cardObj.tag ~= "Tile" then
            broadcastToAll("Ignored object: Only Tile objects can be saved.", {1, 0.5, 0})
            return nil
        end

        local cardData = {
            name = cardObj.getName() or "Unknown Ship",
            json = nil,
            imageURL = "",
            tonnage = "Light",
            baseScale = 1,
        }

        -- Capture the exact JSON of the object (Tile)
        -- We use this exactly as saved for spawning
        cardData.json = cardObj.getJSON()

        -- Extract Image URL for the UI listing (from CustomObject)
        local customObj = cardObj.getCustomObject()
        if customObj and customObj.image then
            cardData.imageURL = customObj.image
        end

        -- Tonnage detection from Description (check for specific ship types)
        local desc = cardObj.getDescription() or ""
        local descLower = string.lower(desc)
        local name = cardObj.getName() or ""
        nameLower = string.lower(name)

        -- Check both description and name for ship type
        local text = descLower .. " " .. nameLower

        -- Ordered from largest to smallest for proper detection
        if string.find(text, "dreadnought") or string.find(text, "dreadnaught") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Dreadnaught"
        elseif string.find(text, "super battleship") or string.find(text, "superbattleship") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Super Battleship"
        elseif string.find(text, "supercarrier") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Supercarrier"
        elseif string.find(text, "battleship") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Battleship"
        elseif string.find(text, "battlecruiser") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Battlecruiser"
        elseif string.find(text, "troopship") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Troopship"
        elseif string.find(text, "heavy cruiser") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Heavy Cruiser"
        elseif string.find(text, "cruiser") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Cruiser"
        elseif string.find(text, "light cruiser") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Light Cruiser"
        elseif string.find(text, "runner") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Runner"
        elseif string.find(text, "destroyer") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Destroyer"
        elseif string.find(text, "cutter") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Cutter"
        elseif string.find(text, "monitor") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Monitor"
        elseif string.find(text, "carrier") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Carrier"
        elseif string.find(text, "frigate") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Frigate"
        elseif string.find(text, "lighter") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Lighter"
        elseif string.find(text, "corvette") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Corvette"
        elseif string.find(text, "cell") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Cell"
        else
            cardData.tonnage = "Other" -- Default for unrecognized types
        end

        -- Attempt to find baseScale in the Lua script for Tonnage Category sorting
        -- (This preserves the existing logic for categorizing ships in the UI)
        local script = cardObj.getLuaScript()
        if script then
            local scale = script:match("baseScale%s*=%s*([%d%.]+)")
            if scale then
                cardData.baseScale = tonumber(scale)
            end
        end

        -- Extract ShipbaseSize from the card's JSON to determine ship tonnage
        -- ShipbaseSize is embedded in the ship model's LuaScript within the card JSON
        cardData.shipTonnage = extractShipTonnageFromObj(cardObj)

    return cardData
end

-- Extracts the ship tonnage (Light/Medium/Heavy/Colossal) from a card object's JSON
-- by finding the ShipbaseSize variable in the embedded ship model LuaScript
function extractShipTonnageFromObj(cardObj)
    local jsonStr = cardObj.getJSON()
    if jsonStr then
        return extractShipTonnageFromJSON(jsonStr)
    end
    return "Light" -- Default fallback
end

-- Extracts the ship tonnage from a raw JSON string by searching for ShipbaseSize
function extractShipTonnageFromJSON(jsonStr)
    if not jsonStr then return "Light" end
    local shipbaseSize = jsonStr:match("ShipbaseSize%s*=%s*(%d+)")
    if shipbaseSize then
        local size = tonumber(shipbaseSize)
        if CONFIG.SHIPBASE_TO_TONNAGE[size] then
            return CONFIG.SHIPBASE_TO_TONNAGE[size]
        end
    end
    return "Light" -- Default fallback
end

-- Ensures all savedShipCards have shipTonnage set (backward compat for old embedded data)
function ensureShipTonnage()
    for _, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
        if not card.shipTonnage or card.shipTonnage == "" then
            if card.json then
                card.shipTonnage = extractShipTonnageFromJSON(card.json)
            else
                card.shipTonnage = "Light"
            end
        end
    end
end

function sortShipCards()
        table.sort(savedShipCards, function(a, b)
        return (a.name or "") < (b.name or "")
    end)
end

function buttonClick_viewShips(obj, player_color)

        end

        if not playerActiveTonnageTabs[player_color] then playerActiveTonnageTabs[player_color] = nil end

        self.clearButtons()

    showShipPickerUI(player_color)
end

function uiShowCustomTooltip(player, value, id)
        local playerColor = player.color
        local tooltipText = value or ""

        -- Support a "BIG|" prefix to indicate a larger tooltip for emphasis (used for class and tonnage tabs)
        local isBig = false
        if tooltipText:sub(1,4) == "BIG|" then
            isBig = true
            tooltipText = tooltipText:sub(5)
        end

        local cfg = CONFIG.UI

        if isBig then
            self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltip_" .. playerColor, "width", tostring(cfg.TOOLTIP_WIDTH))
            self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltip_" .. playerColor, "height", tostring(cfg.TOOLTIP_HEIGHT))
            self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltipText_" .. playerColor, "fontSize", tostring(cfg.TOOLTIP_FONT_SIZE))
        else
            -- Ensure defaults for normal tooltips
            self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltip_" .. playerColor, "width", "400")
            self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltip_" .. playerColor, "height", "60")
            self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltipText_" .. playerColor, "fontSize", "18")
        end

        self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltip_" .. playerColor, "active", "true")
    self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltipText_" .. playerColor, "text", tooltipText)
end

function uiHideCustomTooltip(player, value, id)
        local playerColor = player.color

        -- Reset to defaults and hide
        self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltip_" .. playerColor, "active", "false")
        self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltip_" .. playerColor, "width", "400")
        self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltip_" .. playerColor, "height", "60")
    self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltipText_" .. playerColor, "text", "")
    self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltipText_" .. playerColor, "fontSize", "18")
end

function getFilteredCards(activeTab, activeTonnageTab, searchFilter)
        local filtered = {}
        local searchLower = string.lower(searchFilter or "")

        for i, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
            local matchesClassTab = (not activeTab) or (card.tonnage == activeTab)
            local matchesTonnageTab = (not activeTonnageTab) or (card.shipTonnage == activeTonnageTab)
            local matchesSearch = (searchFilter == "") or string.find(string.lower(card.name or ""), searchLower, 1, true)

            if matchesClassTab and matchesTonnageTab and matchesSearch then
                local cardCopy = duplicateTable(card)
                cardCopy.originalIndex = i
                table.insert(filtered, cardCopy)
            end
        end

    return filtered
end

function countCardsInCategory(categoryName)
        local count = 0
        for _, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
            if card.tonnage == categoryName then
                count = count + 1
            end
        end
    return count
end

function countCardsInTonnage(tonnageName)
        local count = 0
        for _, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
            if card.shipTonnage == tonnageName then
                count = count + 1
            end
        end
    return count
end

function escapeXml(str)
        if not str then return "" end
        str = str:gsub("&", "&")
        str = str:gsub("<", "<")
        str = str:gsub(">", ">")
        str = str:gsub('"', """)
        str = str:gsub("'", "'")
    return str
end

function uiCloseButton(player, value, id)
        self.UI.setXml("")  -- Clear ALL UI

        -- Restore buttons if they were cleared
        if self.getButtons() == nil or #self.getButtons() == 0 then
        createMainButtonsWithList()
    end
end

function uiSearchChanged(player, value, id)
        local playerColor = player.color
        playerSearchFilters[playerColor] = value or ""
    Wait.time(function() showShipPickerUI(playerColor) end, 0.1)
end

function uiClearSearch(player, value, id)
        local playerColor = player.color
        playerSearchFilters[playerColor] = ""
    playerCardIndices[playerColor] = 1
    Wait.time(function() showShipPickerUI(playerColor) end, 0.1)
end

function uiTabClicked(player, value, id)
    local playerColor = player.color

    -- Spawns selected cards for a player at their play area
    function spawnCardsForPlayer(playerColor, cardIndices)
        if not playerSpawnCounts then playerSpawnCounts = {} end

        local spawnConfig = CONFIG.PLAYER_SPAWN_POSITIONS[playerColor]

        if not spawnConfig then
            -- Default spawn position if player color not configured
            spawnConfig = {
                position = {x = 0, y = 1, z = 0},
                rotation = {x = 0, y = 0, z = 0},
                direction = {x = 1, y = 0, z = 0},
            }
            broadcastToColor("Warning: No spawn position configured for " .. playerColor .. ", using center.", playerColor, {1, 1, 0})
        end

        local startPos = spawnConfig.position
        local rotation = spawnConfig.rotation
        local direction = spawnConfig.direction
        local spacing = CONFIG.CARD_SPAWN_SPACING
        local cardsPerRow = CONFIG.CARDS_PER_ROW or 6

        -- Calculate perpendicular "row" direction (rotated 90 degrees on the horizontal plane)
        local rowDirection = {
            x = direction.z,
            y = 0,
            z = direction.x,
        }

        -- Get persistent spawn count for this player
        local currentCount = playerSpawnCounts[playerColor] or 0

        for i, cardIndex in ipairs(cardIndices) do
            local card = savedShipCards[cardIndex]
            if card and card.json then
                -- Calculate column and row from cumulative count
                local col = currentCount % cardsPerRow
                local row = math.floor(currentCount / cardsPerRow)

                -- Calculate spawn position: col along direction, row along perpendicular
                local colOffset = col * spacing
                local rowOffset = row * spacing
                local spawnPos = {
                    x = startPos.x + (direction.x * colOffset) + (rowDirection.x * rowOffset),
                    y = startPos.y,
                    z = startPos.z + (direction.z * colOffset) + (rowDirection.z * rowOffset),
                }

                -- Spawn the card
                spawnObjectJSON({
                    json = card.json,
                    position = spawnPos,
                    rotation = rotation,
                    sound = true,
                })

                -- Increment count for next card
                currentCount = currentCount + 1
            end
        end

    -- Update persistent count
    playerSpawnCounts[playerColor] = currentCount
end

function duplicateTable(oldTable)
        if type(oldTable) ~= "table" then return oldTable end

        local newTable = {}
        for k, v in pairs(oldTable) do
            if type(v) == "table" then
                newTable[k] = duplicateTable(v)
            else
                newTable[k] = v
            end
        end
    return newTable
end

function round(num, dec)
        local mult = 10 ^ (dec or 0)
    return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
end

function stripBrackets(str)
        if not str then return "" end
        -- Check for [=[ ... ]=] style first
        local s, e = str:find("^%[=%[.*%]=%]$")
        if s then return str:sub(4, -4) end

        -- Check for [[ ... ]] style
        s, e = str:find("^%[%[.*%]%]$")
        if s then return str:sub(3, -3) end

    return str
end

function parseAndSpawnList(listText, playerColor)
    local lines = splitIntoLines(listText)
    local shipEntries = extractShipEntries(lines)

    if #shipEntries == 0 then
        broadcastToColor("No ships found in the list. Make sure the format is correct.", playerColor, {1, 0.5, 0})
        return
    end

    local spawnedCount = 0
    local notFoundList = {}

    -- Only spawn one of each ship from the list (duplicates and quantities are ignored)
    local seen = {}
    local uniqueEntries = {}
    for _, entry in ipairs(shipEntries) do
        local key = (entry.name or ""):lower()
        key = trimString(key)
        if key ~= "" and not seen[key] then
            seen[key] = true
            table.insert(uniqueEntries, entry)
        end
    end

    for _, entry in ipairs(uniqueEntries) do
        local shipName = entry.name
        local matchedCards = findMatchingCards(shipName)

        if #matchedCards > 0 then
            local cardIndex = matchedCards[1]
            spawnCardsForPlayer(playerColor, {cardIndex})
            spawnedCount = spawnedCount + 1
        else
            table.insert(notFoundList, shipName)
        end
    end

    if spawnedCount > 0 then
        broadcastToColor("Spawned " .. spawnedCount .. " ship cards from list.", playerColor, {0.2, 1, 0.3})
    end

    if #notFoundList > 0 then
        local notFoundMsg = "Warning: Could not find cards for: "
        for i, name in ipairs(notFoundList) do
            if i > 1 then notFoundMsg = notFoundMsg .. ", " end
            notFoundMsg = notFoundMsg .. name
            if i >= 5 then
                notFoundMsg = notFoundMsg .. " (and more...)"
                break
            end
        end
        broadcastToColor(notFoundMsg, playerColor, {1, 1, 0})
    end
end

function splitIntoLines(text)
        local lines = {}
        local currentLine = ""
        for i = 1, #text do
            local char = text:sub(i, i)
            if char == "\n" or char == "\r" then
                if #currentLine > 0 then
                    table.insert(lines, currentLine)
                    currentLine = ""
                end
            else
                currentLine = currentLine .. char
            end
        end
        if #currentLine > 0 then
            table.insert(lines, currentLine)
        end
    return lines
end

function removeLineNumber(line)
        local dotPos = findChar(line, ".")
        if dotPos and dotPos < 5 then
            local beforeDot = trimString(line:sub(1, dotPos - 1))
            if isNumeric(beforeDot) then
                return trimString(line:sub(dotPos + 1))
            end
        end
    return line
end

function extractShipEntries(lines)
        local entries = {}
        for _, line in ipairs(lines) do
            line = trimString(line)
            if #line > 0 and not isHeaderLine(line) then
                local entry = parseShipLine(line)
                if entry then
                    table.insert(entries, entry)
                end
            end
        end
    return entries
end

function isHeaderLine(line)
        if #line == 0 then return true end
        if line:sub(1, 1) == "#" then return true end

    local lowerLine = line:lower()

    if contains(lowerLine, "configuration") or
       contains(lowerLine, "game size") or
       contains(lowerLine, "fleet ++") or
       contains(lowerLine, "famous admirals") then
        return true
    end

    if (contains(lowerLine, "admirals") or contains(lowerLine, "groups")) and
       contains(lowerLine, "[") and contains(lowerLine, "pts]") then
        if not contains(lowerLine, "•") and not contains(line, "x ") then
            return true
        end
    end

    return false
end

function parseShipLine(line)
    line = trimString(line)
    if #line == 0 then return nil end

    line = removeLineNumber(line)
    line = trimString(line)

    local colonPos = findChar(line, ":")
    local bulletPresent = (line:sub(1, 1) == "•" or line:sub(1, 1) == "-" or line:sub(1, 1) == "*")

    if colonPos == #line and not bulletPresent then
        local hasQuantity = false
        for i = 1, 6 do
            if i < #line and line:sub(i, i) == "x" and line:sub(i+1, i+1) == " " then
                hasQuantity = true
                break
            end
        end
        if not hasQuantity then
            return nil
        end
    end

    if bulletPresent then
        line = trimString(line:sub(2))
    end

    local quantity = 1
    local xPos = findChar(line, "x")
    if xPos and xPos < 6 then
        local beforeX = trimString(line:sub(1, xPos - 1))
        if isNumeric(beforeX) then
            quantity = tonumber(beforeX) or 1
            line = trimString(line:sub(xPos + 2))
        end
    end

    local bracketPos = findChar(line, "[")
    colonPos = findChar(line, ":")

    local nameEnd = #line
    if bracketPos and (not colonPos or bracketPos < colonPos) then
        nameEnd = bracketPos - 1
    elseif colonPos then
        nameEnd = colonPos - 1
    end

    local shipName = trimString(line:sub(1, nameEnd))

    if #shipName < 3 then return nil end

    local lowerName = shipName:lower()

    if contains(lowerName, "lvl ") or contains(lowerName, "captain") or contains(lowerName, "admiral") then
        return nil
    end

    if contains(shipName, " - ") and (shipName:sub(-2) == " -" or contains(shipName, "pts]")) then
        return nil
    end

    return {name = shipName, quantity = quantity}
end

function findMatchingCards(searchName)
    local matches = {}
    local searchLower = searchName:lower()

    for i, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
        local cardName = (card.name or "")
        local cardLower = cardName:lower()

        if cardLower == searchLower then
            table.insert(matches, i)
        elseif contains(searchLower, cardLower) then
            table.insert(matches, i)
        elseif contains(cardLower, searchLower) then
            table.insert(matches, i)
        end
    end

    return matches
end
function trimString(str)
    if not str then return "" end
    local startPos = 1
    while startPos <= #str do
        local char = str:sub(startPos, startPos)
        if char ~= " " and char ~= "\t" and char ~= "\r" and char ~= "\n" then
            break
        end
        startPos = startPos + 1
    end
    local endPos = #str
    while endPos >= 1 do
        local char = str:sub(endPos, endPos)
        if char ~= " " and char ~= "\t" and char ~= "\r" and char ~= "\n" then
            break
        end
        endPos = endPos - 1
    end
    if startPos > endPos then return "" end
    return str:sub(startPos, endPos)
end

function findChar(str, char)
    for i = 1, #str do
        if str:sub(i, i) == char then
            return i
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function contains(str, substr)
    if not str or not substr then return false end
    if #substr > #str then return false end
    for i = 1, #str - #substr + 1 do
        local match = true
        for j = 1, #substr do
            if str:sub(i + j - 1, i + j - 1) ~= substr:sub(j, j) then
                match = false
                break
            end
        end
        if match then return true end
    end
    return false
end

function isNumeric(str)
    if not str or #str == 0 then return false end
    for i = 1, #str do
        local char = str:sub(i, i)
        if char < "0" or char > "9" then
            return false
        end
    end
    return true
end

        embeddedData = embeddedData .. "fresh = " .. tostring(fresh) .. "\n"

        script = script .. embeddedData
        self.setLuaScript(script)
    end

function onLoad(saved_data)
        selfGUID = self.getGUID()

        -- Initialize variables if they don't exist
        if savedShipCards == nil then
            savedShipCards = {}
        end
        if fresh == nil then
            fresh = true
        end

        -- Update fresh status based on data
        if #savedShipCards > 0 then
            fresh = false
        end

        -- Initialize player state tables
        playerSelections = {}
        playerCardIndices = {}
        playerSearchFilters = {}
        playerActiveTabs = {}
        playerActiveTonnageTabs = {}
        playerSpawnCounts = {}

        -- Clean loaded data
        for _, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
            if card.json then card.json = stripBrackets(card.json) end
            if card.imageURL then card.imageURL = stripBrackets(card.imageURL) end
        end

        -- Ensure all cards have shipTonnage extracted from their JSON
        ensureShipTonnage()

    -- Show appropriate buttons
    if fresh then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMainButtonsWithList()
    end
end

function createButton_helper(params)
        local defaults = {
            function_owner = self,
            rotation = {0, 0, 0},
            font_color = {1, 1, 1}
        }

        -- Merge params with defaults
        local buttonConfig = {}
        for k, v in pairs(defaults) do
            buttonConfig[k] = v
        end
        for k, v in pairs(params) do
            buttonConfig[k] = v
        end

    self.createButton(buttonConfig)
end

function createSetupButton()
        self.clearButtons()
        self.clearInputs()

        createButton_helper({
            label = "Setup",
            click_function = "buttonClick_setup",
            position = {0, 1, 0},
            height = 350,
            width = 800,
            font_size = 250,
        color = {0.2, 0.2, 0.3}
    })
end

function createSetupActionButtons()
        self.clearButtons()
        self.clearInputs()

        -- Compact stacked layout (vertical) — smaller buttons
        local btnHeight = 60
        local btnWidth  = 380
        local btnFont   = 60
        local zStart    = 1.2
        local zSpacing  = -0.25

        -- Cancel button (top)
        createButton_helper({
            label = "Cancel",
            click_function = "buttonClick_cancel",
            position = {0, 1, zStart},
            height = btnHeight,
            width = btnWidth,
            font_size = btnFont,
            color = {0.4, 0.2, 0.2}
        })

        -- Add button (below Cancel)
        createButton_helper({
            label = "Add Ships",
            click_function = "buttonClick_add",
            position = {0, 1, zStart + zSpacing},
            height = btnHeight,
            width = btnWidth,
            font_size = btnFont,
            color = {0.2, 0.5, 0.2}
        })

        -- Remove button (only if cards exist)
        if not fresh then
            createButton_helper({
                label = "Remove Ships",
                click_function = "buttonClick_remove",
                position = {0, 1, zStart + (2 * zSpacing)},
                height = btnHeight,
                width = btnWidth,
                font_size = btnFont,
                color = {0.5, 0.2, 0.2}
            })
        end

        -- Reset button (bottom)
        createButton_helper({
            label = "Reset",
            click_function = "buttonClick_reset",
            position = {0, 1, zStart + (3 * zSpacing)},
            height = btnHeight,
            width = btnWidth,
            font_size = btnFont,
            color = {0.3, 0.3, 0.3}
        })
    end

--==============================================================================
-- SETUP MODE FUNCTIONS
--==============================================================================

function buttonClick_setup()
        savedShipCardsBackup = duplicateTable(savedShipCards)
    createSetupActionButtons()
    broadcastToAll("Setup Mode: Box-select ship cards, then click Add/Remove", {1, 1, 1})
end

function buttonClick_cancel()
        savedShipCards = savedShipCardsBackup

        if #savedShipCards == 0 then
            createSetupButton()
        else
            createMainButtonsWithList()
        end

    broadcastToAll("Setup Canceled", {1, 1, 1})
end

function buttonClick_add(obj, player_color)
        local selectedObjs = Player[player_color].getSelectedObjects()
        local count = 0

        for _, selectedObj in ipairs(selectedObjs) do
            if selectedObj and not selectedObj.isDestroyed() and selectedObj ~= self then
                -- Check if it's a card or tile
                if selectedObj.tag == "Card" or selectedObj.tag == "Tile" then
                    -- Check if already saved (by name comparison)
                    local cardName = selectedObj.getName()
                    local alreadyExists = false

                    for _, saved in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
                        if saved.name == cardName then
                            alreadyExists = true
                            break
                        end
                    end

                    if not alreadyExists then
                        -- Extract card data
                        local cardData = extractCardData(selectedObj)
                        if cardData then
                            table.insert(savedShipCards, cardData)
                            count = count + 1
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        if count > 0 then
            fresh = false
            -- Sort cards alphabetically
            sortShipCards()
            updateSave()
            broadcastToAll(count .. " ship card(s) added to " .. CONFIG.FACTION_NAME .. " Ship Picker", {0.2, 1, 0.2})
        else
            broadcastToAll("No new cards to add (select Card objects)", {1, 0.5, 0.5})
        end

    createMainButtonsWithList()
end

function buttonClick_remove(obj, player_color)
        local selectedObjs = Player[player_color].getSelectedObjects()
        local count = 0

        local newSavedCards = {}

        for _, saved in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
            local shouldRemove = false

            for _, selectedObj in ipairs(selectedObjs) do
                if selectedObj and not selectedObj.isDestroyed() then
                    if selectedObj.getName() == saved.name then
                        shouldRemove = true
                        count = count + 1
                        break
                    end
                end
            end

            if not shouldRemove then
                table.insert(newSavedCards, saved)
            end
        end

        savedShipCards = newSavedCards

        if #savedShipCards == 0 then
            fresh = true
            createSetupButton()
        else
            createMainButtonsWithList()
        end

        updateSave()
    broadcastToAll(count .. " ship card(s) removed from " .. CONFIG.FACTION_NAME .. " Ship Picker", {1, 0.5, 0.5})
end

function buttonClick_reset()
        fresh = true
        savedShipCards = {}
        savedShipCardsBackup = {}
        playerSelections = {}
        playerSearchFilters = {}
        playerActiveTabs = {}
        playerSpawnCounts = {}

        createSetupButton()
        updateSave()
    broadcastToAll(CONFIG.FACTION_NAME .. " Ship Picker Reset", {1, 1, 1})
end

--==============================================================================
-- CARD DATA EXTRACTION
--==============================================================================

function extractCardData(cardObj)
        if not cardObj then return nil end

        -- Only allow Tile objects
        if cardObj.tag ~= "Tile" then
            broadcastToAll("Ignored object: Only Tile objects can be saved.", {1, 0.5, 0})
            return nil
        end

        local cardData = {
            name = cardObj.getName() or "Unknown Ship",
            json = nil,
            imageURL = "",
            tonnage = "Light",
            baseScale = 1,
        }

        -- Capture the exact JSON of the object (Tile)
        -- We use this exactly as saved for spawning
        cardData.json = cardObj.getJSON()

        -- Extract Image URL for the UI listing (from CustomObject)
        local customObj = cardObj.getCustomObject()
        if customObj and customObj.image then
            cardData.imageURL = customObj.image
        end

        -- Tonnage detection from Description (check for specific ship types)
        local desc = cardObj.getDescription() or ""
        local descLower = string.lower(desc)
        local name = cardObj.getName() or ""
        nameLower = string.lower(name)

        -- Check both description and name for ship type
        local text = descLower .. " " .. nameLower

        -- Ordered from largest to smallest for proper detection
        if string.find(text, "dreadnought") or string.find(text, "dreadnaught") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Dreadnaught"
        elseif string.find(text, "super battleship") or string.find(text, "superbattleship") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Super Battleship"
        elseif string.find(text, "supercarrier") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Supercarrier"
        elseif string.find(text, "battleship") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Battleship"
        elseif string.find(text, "battlecruiser") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Battlecruiser"
        elseif string.find(text, "troopship") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Troopship"
        elseif string.find(text, "heavy cruiser") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Heavy Cruiser"
        elseif string.find(text, "cruiser") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Cruiser"
        elseif string.find(text, "light cruiser") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Light Cruiser"
        elseif string.find(text, "runner") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Runner"
        elseif string.find(text, "destroyer") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Destroyer"
        elseif string.find(text, "cutter") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Cutter"
        elseif string.find(text, "monitor") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Monitor"
        elseif string.find(text, "carrier") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Carrier"
        elseif string.find(text, "frigate") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Frigate"
        elseif string.find(text, "lighter") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Lighter"
        elseif string.find(text, "corvette") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Corvette"
        elseif string.find(text, "cell") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Cell"
        else
            cardData.tonnage = "Other" -- Default for unrecognized types
        end

        -- Attempt to find baseScale in the Lua script for Tonnage Category sorting
        -- (This preserves the existing logic for categorizing ships in the UI)
        local script = cardObj.getLuaScript()
        if script then
            local scale = script:match("baseScale%s*=%s*([%d%.]+)")
            if scale then
                cardData.baseScale = tonumber(scale)
            end
        end

        -- Extract ShipbaseSize from the card's JSON to determine ship tonnage
        -- ShipbaseSize is embedded in the ship model's LuaScript within the card JSON
        cardData.shipTonnage = extractShipTonnageFromObj(cardObj)

    return cardData
end

-- Extracts the ship tonnage (Light/Medium/Heavy/Colossal) from a card object's JSON
-- by finding the ShipbaseSize variable in the embedded ship model LuaScript
function extractShipTonnageFromObj(cardObj)
    local jsonStr = cardObj.getJSON()
    if jsonStr then
        return extractShipTonnageFromJSON(jsonStr)
    end
    return "Light" -- Default fallback
end

-- Extracts the ship tonnage from a raw JSON string by searching for ShipbaseSize
function extractShipTonnageFromJSON(jsonStr)
    if not jsonStr then return "Light" end
    local shipbaseSize = jsonStr:match("ShipbaseSize%s*=%s*(%d+)")
    if shipbaseSize then
        local size = tonumber(shipbaseSize)
        if CONFIG.SHIPBASE_TO_TONNAGE[size] then
            return CONFIG.SHIPBASE_TO_TONNAGE[size]
        end
    end
    return "Light" -- Default fallback
end

-- Ensures all savedShipCards have shipTonnage set (backward compat for old embedded data)
function ensureShipTonnage()
    for _, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
        if not card.shipTonnage or card.shipTonnage == "" then
            if card.json then
                card.shipTonnage = extractShipTonnageFromJSON(card.json)
            else
                card.shipTonnage = "Light"
            end
        end
    end
end

function sortShipCards()
        table.sort(savedShipCards, function(a, b)
        return (a.name or "") < (b.name or "")
    end)
end

function uiShowCustomTooltip(player, value, id)
        local playerColor = player.color
        local tooltipText = value or ""

        -- Support a "BIG|" prefix to indicate a larger tooltip for emphasis (used for class and tonnage tabs)
        local isBig = false
        if tooltipText:sub(1,4) == "BIG|" then
            isBig = true
            tooltipText = tooltipText:sub(5)
        end

        local cfg = CONFIG.UI

        if isBig then
            self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltip_" .. playerColor, "width", tostring(cfg.TOOLTIP_WIDTH))
            self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltip_" .. playerColor, "height", tostring(cfg.TOOLTIP_HEIGHT))
            self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltipText_" .. playerColor, "fontSize", tostring(cfg.TOOLTIP_FONT_SIZE))
        else
            -- Ensure defaults for normal tooltips
            self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltip_" .. playerColor, "width", "400")
            self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltip_" .. playerColor, "height", "60")
            self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltipText_" .. playerColor, "fontSize", "18")
        end

        self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltip_" .. playerColor, "active", "true")
    self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltipText_" .. playerColor, "text", tooltipText)
end

function uiHideCustomTooltip(player, value, id)
        local playerColor = player.color

        -- Reset to defaults and hide
        self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltip_" .. playerColor, "active", "false")
        self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltip_" .. playerColor, "width", "400")
        self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltip_" .. playerColor, "height", "60")
    self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltipText_" .. playerColor, "text", "")
    self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltipText_" .. playerColor, "fontSize", "18")
end

function getFilteredCards(activeTab, activeTonnageTab, searchFilter)
        local filtered = {}
        local searchLower = string.lower(searchFilter or "")

        for i, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
            local matchesClassTab = (not activeTab) or (card.tonnage == activeTab)
            local matchesTonnageTab = (not activeTonnageTab) or (card.shipTonnage == activeTonnageTab)
            local matchesSearch = (searchFilter == "") or string.find(string.lower(card.name or ""), searchLower, 1, true)

            if matchesClassTab and matchesTonnageTab and matchesSearch then
                local cardCopy = duplicateTable(card)
                cardCopy.originalIndex = i
                table.insert(filtered, cardCopy)
            end
        end

    return filtered

    -- Spawns selected cards for a player at their play area
    function spawnCardsForPlayer(playerColor, cardIndices)
        if not playerSpawnCounts then playerSpawnCounts = {} end

        local spawnConfig = CONFIG.PLAYER_SPAWN_POSITIONS[playerColor]

        if not spawnConfig then
            -- Default spawn position if player color not configured
            spawnConfig = {
                position = {x = 0, y = 1, z = 0},
                rotation = {x = 0, y = 0, z = 0},
                direction = {x = 1, y = 0, z = 0},
            }
            broadcastToColor("Warning: No spawn position configured for " .. playerColor .. ", using center.", playerColor, {1, 1, 0})
        end

        local startPos = spawnConfig.position
        local rotation = spawnConfig.rotation
        local direction = spawnConfig.direction
        local spacing = CONFIG.CARD_SPAWN_SPACING
        local cardsPerRow = CONFIG.CARDS_PER_ROW or 6

        -- Calculate perpendicular "row" direction (rotated 90 degrees on the horizontal plane)
        local rowDirection = {
            x = direction.z,
            y = 0,
            z = direction.x,
        }

        -- Get persistent spawn count for this player
        local currentCount = playerSpawnCounts[playerColor] or 0

        for i, cardIndex in ipairs(cardIndices) do
            local card = savedShipCards[cardIndex]
            if card and card.json then
                -- Calculate column and row from cumulative count
                local col = currentCount % cardsPerRow
                local row = math.floor(currentCount / cardsPerRow)

                -- Calculate spawn position: col along direction, row along perpendicular
                local colOffset = col * spacing
                local rowOffset = row * spacing
                local spawnPos = {
                    x = startPos.x + (direction.x * colOffset) + (rowDirection.x * rowOffset),
                    y = startPos.y,
                    z = startPos.z + (direction.z * colOffset) + (rowDirection.z * rowOffset),
                }

                -- Spawn the card
                spawnObjectJSON({
                    json = card.json,
                    position = spawnPos,
                    rotation = rotation,
                    sound = true,
                })

                -- Increment count for next card
                currentCount = currentCount + 1
            end
        end

    -- Update persistent count
    playerSpawnCounts[playerColor] = currentCount
end

function duplicateTable(oldTable)
        if type(oldTable) ~= "table" then return oldTable end

        local newTable = {}
        for k, v in pairs(oldTable) do
            if type(v) == "table" then
                newTable[k] = duplicateTable(v)
            else
                newTable[k] = v
            end
        end
    return newTable
end

function round(num, dec)
        local mult = 10 ^ (dec or 0)
    return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
end

function stripBrackets(str)
        if not str then return "" end
        -- Check for [=[ ... ]=] style first
        local s, e = str:find("^%[=%[.*%]=%]$")
        if s then return str:sub(4, -4) end

        -- Check for [[ ... ]] style
        s, e = str:find("^%[%[.*%]%]$")
        if s then return str:sub(3, -3) end

    return str
end

function parseAndSpawnList(listText, playerColor)
    local lines = splitIntoLines(listText)
    local shipEntries = extractShipEntries(lines)

    if #shipEntries == 0 then
        broadcastToColor("No ships found in the list. Make sure the format is correct.", playerColor, {1, 0.5, 0})
        return
    end

    local spawnedCount = 0
    local notFoundList = {}

    -- Only spawn one of each ship from the list (duplicates and quantities are ignored)
    local seen = {}
    local uniqueEntries = {}
    for _, entry in ipairs(shipEntries) do
        local key = (entry.name or ""):lower()
        key = trimString(key)
        if key ~= "" and not seen[key] then
            seen[key] = true
            table.insert(uniqueEntries, entry)
        end
    end

    for _, entry in ipairs(uniqueEntries) do
        local shipName = entry.name
        local matchedCards = findMatchingCards(shipName)

        if #matchedCards > 0 then
            local cardIndex = matchedCards[1]
            spawnCardsForPlayer(playerColor, {cardIndex})
            spawnedCount = spawnedCount + 1
        else
            table.insert(notFoundList, shipName)
        end
    end

    if spawnedCount > 0 then
        broadcastToColor("Spawned " .. spawnedCount .. " ship cards from list.", playerColor, {0.2, 1, 0.3})
    end

    if #notFoundList > 0 then
        local notFoundMsg = "Warning: Could not find cards for: "
        for i, name in ipairs(notFoundList) do
            if i > 1 then notFoundMsg = notFoundMsg .. ", " end
            notFoundMsg = notFoundMsg .. name
            if i >= 5 then
                notFoundMsg = notFoundMsg .. " (and more...)"
                break
            end
        end
        broadcastToColor(notFoundMsg, playerColor, {1, 1, 0})
    end
end

function splitIntoLines(text)
        local lines = {}
        local currentLine = ""
        for i = 1, #text do
            local char = text:sub(i, i)
            if char == "\n" or char == "\r" then
                if #currentLine > 0 then
                    table.insert(lines, currentLine)
                    currentLine = ""
                end
            else
                currentLine = currentLine .. char
            end
        end
        if #currentLine > 0 then
            table.insert(lines, currentLine)
        end
    return lines
end

function removeLineNumber(line)
        local dotPos = findChar(line, ".")
        if dotPos and dotPos < 5 then
            local beforeDot = trimString(line:sub(1, dotPos - 1))
            if isNumeric(beforeDot) then
                return trimString(line:sub(dotPos + 1))
            end
        end
    return line
end

function extractShipEntries(lines)
        local entries = {}
        for _, line in ipairs(lines) do
            line = trimString(line)
            if #line > 0 and not isHeaderLine(line) then
                local entry = parseShipLine(line)
                if entry then
                    table.insert(entries, entry)
                end
            end
        end
    return entries
end

function isHeaderLine(line)
        if #line == 0 then return true end
        if line:sub(1, 1) == "#" then return true end

    local lowerLine = line:lower()

    if contains(lowerLine, "configuration") or
       contains(lowerLine, "game size") or
       contains(lowerLine, "fleet ++") or
       contains(lowerLine, "famous admirals") then
        return true
    end

    if (contains(lowerLine, "admirals") or contains(lowerLine, "groups")) and
       contains(lowerLine, "[") and contains(lowerLine, "pts]") then
        if not contains(lowerLine, "•") and not contains(line, "x ") then
            return true
        end
    end

    return false
end

function parseShipLine(line)
    line = trimString(line)
    if #line == 0 then return nil end

    line = removeLineNumber(line)
    line = trimString(line)

    local colonPos = findChar(line, ":")
    local bulletPresent = (line:sub(1, 1) == "•" or line:sub(1, 1) == "-" or line:sub(1, 1) == "*")

    if colonPos == #line and not bulletPresent then
        local hasQuantity = false
        for i = 1, 6 do
            if i < #line and line:sub(i, i) == "x" and line:sub(i+1, i+1) == " " then
                hasQuantity = true
                break
            end
        end
        if not hasQuantity then
            return nil
        end
    end

    if bulletPresent then
        line = trimString(line:sub(2))
    end

    local quantity = 1
    local xPos = findChar(line, "x")
    if xPos and xPos < 6 then
        local beforeX = trimString(line:sub(1, xPos - 1))
        if isNumeric(beforeX) then
            quantity = tonumber(beforeX) or 1
            line = trimString(line:sub(xPos + 2))
        end
    end

    local bracketPos = findChar(line, "[")
    colonPos = findChar(line, ":")

    local nameEnd = #line
    if bracketPos and (not colonPos or bracketPos < colonPos) then
        nameEnd = bracketPos - 1
    elseif colonPos then
        nameEnd = colonPos - 1
    end

    local shipName = trimString(line:sub(1, nameEnd))

    if #shipName < 3 then return nil end

    local lowerName = shipName:lower()

    if contains(lowerName, "lvl ") or contains(lowerName, "captain") or contains(lowerName, "admiral") then
        return nil
    end

    if contains(shipName, " - ") and (shipName:sub(-2) == " -" or contains(shipName, "pts]")) then
        return nil
    end

    return {name = shipName, quantity = quantity}
end

function findMatchingCards(searchName)
    local matches = {}
    local searchLower = searchName:lower()

    for i, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
        local cardName = (card.name or "")
        local cardLower = cardName:lower()

        if cardLower == searchLower then
            table.insert(matches, i)
        elseif contains(searchLower, cardLower) then
            table.insert(matches, i)
        elseif contains(cardLower, searchLower) then
            table.insert(matches, i)
        end
    end

    return matches
end
function trimString(str)
    if not str then return "" end
    local startPos = 1
    while startPos <= #str do
        local char = str:sub(startPos, startPos)
        if char ~= " " and char ~= "\t" and char ~= "\r" and char ~= "\n" then
            break
        end
        startPos = startPos + 1
    end
    local endPos = #str
    while endPos >= 1 do
        local char = str:sub(endPos, endPos)
        if char ~= " " and char ~= "\t" and char ~= "\r" and char ~= "\n" then
            break
        end
        endPos = endPos - 1
    end
    if startPos > endPos then return "" end
    return str:sub(startPos, endPos)
end

function findChar(str, char)
    for i = 1, #str do
        if str:sub(i, i) == char then
            return i
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function contains(str, substr)
    if not str or not substr then return false end
    if #substr > #str then return false end
    for i = 1, #str - #substr + 1 do
        local match = true
        for j = 1, #substr do
            if str:sub(i + j - 1, i + j - 1) ~= substr:sub(j, j) then
                match = false
                break
            end
        end
        if match then return true end
    end
    return false
end

function isNumeric(str)
    if not str or #str == 0 then return false end
    for i = 1, #str do
        local char = str:sub(i, i)
        if char < "0" or char > "9" then
            return false
        end
    end
    return true
end
